Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.in.http.dto.paymentexecution

Record Class KfeTransactionResponse

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.in.http.dto.paymentexecution.KfeTransactionResponse
Record Components:
id - stable transaction identifier
status - persisted transaction lifecycle status
displayStatus - coarse UI badge retained for simple list views
productStatus - canonical product lifecycle status for detailed UI behavior
rail - payment rail used to execute the transfer
direction - whether value is incoming or outgoing from the user's perspective
walletId - wallet used as the transaction's primary perspective
sourceWalletId - source wallet, if known
destinationWalletId - destination wallet, if internal
walletLabel - user-facing label of the primary perspective wallet
sourceWalletLabel - display label of the source wallet, if known
destinationWalletLabel - display label of the destination wallet, if known
counterpartyLabel - privacy-safe label for the other party or external destination
grossAmountSats - gross transfer amount before fees
receiverAmountSats - amount expected to reach the receiver
networkFeeSats - network or rail fee charged for execution
keroseneFeeSats - platform service fee
totalDebitSats - total amount debited from the source wallet
displayBtcUsd - BTC/USD display price used for this projection
displayBtcEur - BTC/EUR display price used for this projection
displayBtcBrl - BTC/BRL display price used for this projection
displayAmountUsd - transaction amount formatted in USD
displayAmountEur - transaction amount formatted in EUR
displayAmountBrl - transaction amount formatted in BRL
quorumProposalHash - proposal hash submitted to vault quorum, when applicable
quorumAckCount - number of quorum acknowledgements recorded
provider - provider name selected for the rail
providerReference - provider-side operation identifier
externalReference - external destination, invoice, or rail-specific reference
memo - user-provided transaction memo
blockchainTxid - on-chain transaction ID, when broadcast
paymentHash - Lightning payment or invoice hash, when applicable
confirmations - number of observed blockchain confirmations
failureCode - stable failure category, when execution failed
failureMessage - safe user-facing failure description
createdAt - transaction creation time
updatedAt - time of the latest persisted transaction update
cancellable - whether the UI may offer cancellation for the current state
cancelTarget - resource type the cancellation endpoint will act on
paymentRequestId - linked payment request identifier, when applicable
paymentRequestPublicId - public payment-request reference, when available
paymentRequestStatus - lifecycle status of the linked payment request
businessStatus - business-level settlement status
networkStatus - external rail or chain status
accountingStatus - ledger posting status
public record KfeTransactionResponse(UUID id, KfeTransactionStatus status, String displayStatus, String productStatus, KfeRail rail, KfeDirection direction, UUID walletId, UUID sourceWalletId, UUID destinationWalletId, String walletLabel, String sourceWalletLabel, String destinationWalletLabel, String counterpartyLabel, long grossAmountSats, long receiverAmountSats, long networkFeeSats, long keroseneFeeSats, long totalDebitSats, BigDecimal displayBtcUsd, BigDecimal displayBtcEur, BigDecimal displayBtcBrl, BigDecimal displayAmountUsd, BigDecimal displayAmountEur, BigDecimal displayAmountBrl, String quorumProposalHash, int quorumAckCount, String provider, String providerReference, String externalReference, String memo, String blockchainTxid, String paymentHash, int confirmations, String failureCode, String failureMessage, Instant createdAt, Instant updatedAt, boolean cancellable, String cancelTarget, UUID paymentRequestId, String paymentRequestPublicId, String paymentRequestStatus, String businessStatus, String networkStatus, String accountingStatus) extends Record
User-facing transaction projection with state, accounting amounts, counterparties, and cancellation affordances. Amounts ending in Sats are integer satoshis; display values are derived fiat/BTC amounts.
